Save a WJP Chart at Its Exact Size

Source: R/save.R
wjp_save.Rd

wjp_save() writes a chart to an SVG, PNG, or PDF file at an exact physical size. SVG files can have their text converted to outlines (outline_text = TRUE), so the figure looks the same on machines without the fonts, and PNG files are rendered at png_dpi dots per inch.

Usage

wjp_save(
  plot,
  file,
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL,
  units = c("in", "cm", "mm", "pt", "px"),
  outline_text = TRUE,
  png_dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

Arguments

plot

A ggplot object.

file

Path of the output file (.svg, .png, or .pdf).

width, height

Size of the figure in units. Default is NULL (the definite size of the chart).

units

Units of width and height: "in" (default), "cm", "mm", "pt" (1/72 inch), or "px" (pixels at png_dpi).

outline_text

Logical. Convert the text of SVG files to outlines. Default is TRUE.

png_dpi

Numeric. Resolution of PNG files. Default is 300.

bg

Background color. Default is "white".

Value

Invisibly, a list with the file, its width and height in inches and, for outlined SVG files, a data frame text with one row per outlined text (text, family, size, weight, italic, font_file, doubtful; doubtful flags texts whose width in the SVG differs by more than 3% from the font, a sign that they were measured with another font).

Details

The output format follows the extension of file:

  • .svg: written with svglite. With outline_text = TRUE, every <text> element is replaced by a <path> with the outlines of its glyphs, read from the font files with systemfonts and shaped with textshaping. Requires the packages svglite, xml2, systemfonts, and textshaping.

  • .png: written with ragg::agg_png() when ragg is installed (otherwise with grDevices::png()) at png_dpi.

  • .pdf: written with grDevices::cairo_pdf().

Fonts: text outlines and the SVG and PNG devices read fonts through systemfonts. Register the WJP fonts with wjp_fonts(engine = "systemfonts") for exact results. When showtext is active and the families of the chart are only known to showtext (the default wjp_fonts()), the chart is drawn with showtext, which already renders text as polygons; outline_text then has no further effect.

Size: when width or height is NULL, the size of the chart is used if it is definite, i.e. when its panels have a fixed size (charts drawn with a wjp_layout(), or plots with the panel.widths and panel.heights theme elements).

See also

wjp_layout() for charts with a definite size.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
wjp_fonts(engine = "systemfonts")
p <- wjp_bars(
  data.frame(country = c("A", "B"), value = c(40, 60)),
  target = "value", grouping = "country"
)
wjp_save(p, "bars.svg", width = 6, height = 4)
wjp_save(p, "bars.png", width = 6, height = 4, png_dpi = 300)
} # }
